subject: [Partner Escalation] BrightForge connector timeouts & SLA mitigation
messages:
From: Tara Singh <tara@brightforge.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>; BrightForge Support <support@brightforge.com>
Cc: Eli Mason <eli.mason@acme-corp.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production timeouts after yesterday's runtime bump

Hi Jonas —

Quick heads up: after BrightForge pushed the runtime patch to use Redwood v1.14 kernels at 06:00 PT, one of our mutual customers (Acme Corp) started seeing 5-10s token-generation timeouts across burst traffic. We captured a handful of request/response traces and two crash dumps attached (bf-connect-logs-20260321.zip).

Symptoms: spikes in 429/timeout at tail latency > 5s, backpressure observed on our side. This started ~06:30 PT and persisted intermittently through morning. Our ops team rolled back to the previous connector image at 08:10 and the incidents dropped but Acme has asked for a formal postmortem and SLA credit conversation.

Can Redwood ops triage whether the kernel selection change contributed or if routing/fallback policies kicked in incorrectly? We flagged the Atlassian ticket INT-1342 with initial logs.

Appreciate an expedited look — Acme is sensitive (pilot for Q2).

Thanks,
Tara Singh
Head of Partner Ops — BrightForge
---
Attachment: bf-connect-logs-20260321.zip (zip, 2.1MB)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara@brightforge.com>, BrightForge Support <support@brightforge.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production timeouts after yesterday's runtime bump

Folks —

Looping you all in. Tara, thanks for the logs. Stephanie: can you prioritize an ops/eng sync this morning? Sergio: can you validate whether the v1.14 kernel change rolled out to the BrightForge cluster and if our smart routing policy could have misclassified the connector variant during the upgrade window? Marissa: pls pull any billing/usage flags for Acme so we can quickly scope potential SLA credits.

High-level ask: we need a triage note (root-candidate), an ETA for a deeper investigation, and a proposed mitigation plan to present to Acme before EOD Monday. If this hits a regression, we need a rollback play and a suggested credit calculation (per our partner SLA).

Jonas Weber
Partner Lead, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0180
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara@brightforge.com>, BrightForge Support <support@brightforge.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production timeouts after yesterday's runtime bump

Jonas / team —

Initial findings from the trace bundle:
- Kernel selection logs show a minority of sessions (approx 6%) landed on the new v1.14 low-latency path that exercises a different KV-cache layout.
- Those sessions correlate with the largest tail latencies and several transient OOMs in the connector sidecar (stack traces in attached zip).
- Smart routing fallback did not trigger because the session affinity flag was set by BrightForge's connector; that prevented transparent fallback to the previous variant.

Short term: recommend BrightForge revert connector affinity for 24h (lets our smart routing shift traffic away from v1.14 nodes) OR we can push a hotfix to the serving runtime to respect an override header.

I've opened INT-1342 with the above notes. I can carve a mitigation PR and smoke test it in our staging cluster today. ETA for PR + smoke: 8-12 hours.

Sergio
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: screenshots-timeouts.png (png, 240KB)
From: Tara Singh <tara@brightforge.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, BrightForge Support <support@brightforge.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 12:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production timeouts after yesterday's runtime bump

Thanks, Sergio —

We can toggle the affinity flag but that requires a coordinated rollout across BrightForge-managed fleets. Our ops lead expects ~3 hours for a safe toggle and validation. If Redwood can provide the override header hotfix faster, we prefer that route since it centralizes control.

One more request from Acme: they want a short SLA amendment that clarifies partner-managed connector upgrades and rollback responsibilities — they'd like explicit credit banding if an upgrade you push causes >1% tail errors for a rolling 4-hour window. I'm attaching a proposed amendment spreadsheet for discussion (proposed-sla-amendment-20260322.xlsx).

Tara
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara@brightforge.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 09:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production timeouts after yesterday's runtime bump

Quick commercial note: Acme is on a pilot plan with a 3-month credit runway. If we assess a partner-impacting regression, we have room for a one-time goodwill credit up to 5% of monthly usage without executive sign-off. Anything above that requires approval from finance + legal. If BrightForge's amendment language becomes permanent, we should route via legal for SLA language and see if we need to update our partner addendum.

I'll draft an internal note on the credit calculation approach (hours impacted x error rate x monthly commitment) and attach a spreadsheet for transparency.

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: credit-calculation-draft.xlsx (xls, 35KB)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Singh <tara@brightforge.com>, BrightForge Support <support@brightforge.com>

Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production timeouts after yesterday's runtime bump

Tara / BrightForge team —

Appreciate the fast coordination. Summary & next steps: 
- Sergio will ship the override header hotfix to canary tonight (INT-1342) and we will monitor tail latency for 4 hours post-deploy.
- If canary looks good, we will backfill the fix to production and run a joint validation window with BrightForge ops on Wednesday 03/25 09:00-11:00 PT.
- Marissa will share the proposed credit calc and thresholds by EOD Tuesday.
- Legal/commercial: I will loop legal for the SLA amendment; Tara, can you share a short redline of the proposed banding you want us to consider? We will treat this as a partner addendum and aim for a clean small-scope change.

Tara: please send the required internal contact for the BrightForge rollout (ops lead + on-call). We'll keep this high priority until validated.

Thanks,
Jonas
Partner Lead, Redwood Inference
